title: feat(hub): execute a pack Do by reference and record it
body:
Second step of executing a pack Do by reference (CL-XXXX). The hub runs one Do named by its verdict reference, at most once, and records it.

- `POST /api/integrations/github-dos/{tenantId}` takes run id, repository, pull request number, action id, branch and index; described with hono-openapi and listed in the OpenAPI document. Gates: portal origin, session, active member, body validation, then use on the GitHub credential, then the run must belong to the workspace (404 otherwise) and the repository must be enabled. The Do is found in the run's recorded verdict, its effect id recomputed and compared, and a verdict without references, or a Do that cannot run (agent, derived labels, skipped), is refused before anything is written. Close and comment are refused when the head moved past the verdict.
- One row per Do effect in a hub-owned table created at boot, additive. A claim takes the row only when it is new, failed, or its two-minute lease expired; a repeat request on a finished Do returns the recorded result as replayed, a concurrent one gets in progress. Settle and fail update only the attempt that holds the claim. The shared executor performs the write; GitHub failures give 502 and a retryable failed row. One structured log line per attempt.
- `GET /api/integrations/github-dos/{tenantId}?repo=&number=` lists the recorded Dos for the workspace, newest first.
- The manual per-kind action route is unchanged; pack Dos stop using it in the portal step that follows.

Verified: `bun run check`; hub and workflow tests against Postgres: two concurrent claims of one effect, a failed row reclaimed with the attempt count going up, an expired lease reclaimed, and a stale claim unable to settle; a spawned hub with a fake GitHub as the API origin and a seeded run log: a labels Do writes once and replays with no second write, a comment Do carries the marker and a pre-seeded marker returns satisfied, another workspace's run gives 404, an agent Do and a forged effect id and a moved head give 409, a GitHub 422 gives 502 with a failed row, the list shows every row, and both paths appear in the OpenAPI document.

Refs CL-XXXX
